what: Every move, item and ability tagged with the PARAMETER it sets, plus whether any feature actually reads that parameter. Tags say "this sets that value", never "special-case this" -- so one damage distribution consumes all of them and there is no per-mechanic branch to get subtly wrong.
derivation: Dex fields where they exist (multihit, willCrit, priority, target, flags, boosts, drain, recoil, selfSwitch, forceSwitch, weather, terrain, sideCondition) and HANDLER PROBES where they do not (onDamagingHit, onSourceModifyDamage, onCriticalHit, onFoeTryMove, onChangeBoost, onModifySpe). Nothing hand-listed, per S13.
consumedBy: CHECKED by grepping engine/board.js and engine/medicham2-browser.js for the tag probe. A tag whose probe appears in neither is reported NOT READ regardless of intent.

tags.param: hits = n (or a distribution)
tags.why: total damage is n x base, and it BREAKS Focus Sash and Sturdy -- the first hit takes the holder to 1, the rest kill

tags.param: P(crit) = 1
tags.why: x1.5 and ignores the defender's positive defensive boosts

tags.param: P(crit) raised
tags.why: a higher crit stage, which the damage distribution should weight rather than ignore

tags.param: type, power or target changes with the weather
tags.why: Weather Ball (4,699 uses), Hydro Steam. Its type is handled; the power and the target change are not

tags.param: power or target changes with the terrain
tags.why: Expanding Force becomes a SPREAD move in Psychic Terrain, Rising Voltage doubles in Electric. Grassy Glide gains priority, which board.js already special-cases

tags.param: basePower is computed, not fixed
tags.why: Gyro Ball, Low Kick, Grass Knot, Weather Ball, Facade, Acrobatics. A fixed bp reads them wrong in both directions

tags.param: damage is a constant, not a formula
tags.why: Seismic Toss and Night Shade ignore stats entirely

tags.param: x0.75, hits BOTH ENEMIES, ally is safe
tags.why: Heat Wave, Hyper Voice, Dazzling Gleam, Blizzard, Make It Rain. Free to click beside a partner

tags.param: x0.75, hits BOTH ENEMIES AND MY PARTNER
tags.why: Earthquake, Rock Slide, Discharge, Surf. This is the one allyHit exists for, and the one that killed its own Archaludon

tags.param: order = priority
tags.why: who moves first, before speed is consulted at all

tags.param: triggers contact punishment on the defender
tags.why: Rocky Helmet, Rough Skin, Iron Barbs, Static, Flame Body all cost you for touching

tags.param: fails into Grass types, Overcoat and Safety Goggles
tags.why: this is how Rage Powder is beaten, and redirection is scored as if it always works

tags.param: bypasses Substitute, blocked by Soundproof
tags.why: also the trigger for Throat Spray

tags.param: P(hit) = 1
tags.why: Aerial Ace, Swift, Flower Trick, Aura Sphere, Magical Leaf. The accuracy feature and the kill probability both scale by P(hit), so a move that CANNOT miss must not be discounted like one that can

tags.param: Protect does NOT stop it
tags.why: Feint, Phantom Force, Future Sight. tgtMayProtect discounts these as if a Protect saves the target, and it does not

tags.param: is a Protect-family move
tags.why: protectThreatened and deadStall both hang off it

tags.param: takes the turn's single-target attacks
tags.why: Follow Me and Rage Powder. A pair feature in DODUO and nothing in the single-move vector

tags.param: damages, then the user leaves
tags.why: U-turn, Flip Turn, Volt Switch. Chip plus momentum, and no switch feature can see either

tags.param: no damage, an effect, then the user leaves
tags.why: Parting Shot (4,782 uses, the most common pivot in the format) and Chilly Reception. The switch is the point and the effect is the payment

tags.param: the incoming Pokemon INHERITS something
tags.why: Baton Pass hands over the stat boosts, Shed Tail hands over a Substitute. Nothing in the model represents a switch that carries state across

tags.param: an HP buffer that absorbs hits and blanks status until it breaks
tags.why: Its own class. Sound moves go through it, and the damage needed to break it is a real number the kill calculation would have to clear first

tags.param: the TARGET is removed from the field
tags.why: Whirlwind, Dragon Tail, Roar. Undoes setup and changes who is in front of you

tags.param: weather := x
tags.why: and whether that weather HELPS is the thing nothing currently asks (task #19)

tags.param: terrain := x, with a second effect beyond the type boost
tags.why: Psychic Terrain blanks priority field-wide (Fake Out is 7,846 uses and nothing checks), Electric blocks sleep, Misty blocks all status, Grassy heals 1/16 a turn

tags.param: speed order is inverted for the whole field
tags.why: Trick Room. MAG set this FOR Will, who had the slowest Pokemon on the field, and was then 4-0ed. It knows the field is ALREADY set (deadField) and cannot ask whether setting it helps

tags.param: Def and SpD are exchanged, field-wide
tags.why: Wonder Room. Every stored damage number is wrong while it is up

tags.param: held items stop working, field-wide
tags.why: Magic Room. Kills Focus Sash, Choice items, Assault Vest and the berries at once

tags.param: another pseudo-weather
tags.why: whatever is left after Trick Room, Wonder Room, Magic Room and Gravity are split out

tags.param: P(hit) is scaled for everyone
tags.why: Gravity (x5/3 and grounds Flying), Sand Attack, Hone Claws. Feeds the same P(hit) the kill distribution already needs

tags.param: blocks ONE NAMED CLASS of move, for one turn, for my whole side
tags.why: Wide Guard blanks spread (2,065 uses), Quick Guard blanks priority (356) -- including Fake Out at 7,846 uses. Different threats, and nothing scores either

tags.param: every stat stage on the field := 0, both sides
tags.why: Haze, 359 uses. The only answer to setup in the format, and it hits YOUR boosts too -- so whether to click it depends on who is ahead on stages, which nothing computes

tags.param: my whole side moves at x2 speed for the duration
tags.why: Tailwind, 6,981 uses. Flips who moves first across every matchup on the field at once, and board.js already derives the speed multiplier -- it just is not scored as a CHOICE

tags.param: incoming damage to my side is roughly halved
tags.why: Light Screen 2,346, Reflect 1,988, Aurora Veil 853 -- 5,187 uses that currently change NO damage number anywhere in MAG

tags.param: the move does NOTHING unless a weather is up
tags.why: Aurora Veil needs snow. Clicking it on a clear field is a wasted turn, and no feature can currently say so

tags.param: another multi-turn modifier on my side
tags.why: Safeguard, Mist -- what is left once Tailwind and the screens are split out

tags.param: their side is damaged or slowed on switch-in, until removed
tags.why: Stealth Rock, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web. Does nothing THIS turn -- it prices their future switches, which is a decision MAG does not model at all

tags.param: WHICH stat stages, on self, not just that there are some
tags.why: movesBoostMe is only a sign. +Spe flips the speed order, +Atk changes damage, +Def changes survival -- three different values reading as one number today

tags.param: positive stat stages on a BODY THAT IS NOT ME
tags.why: Coaching (525 uses), Decorate, Howl, Aromatic Mist. Aimed at the partner in every real game, and DODUO has boostsPartnerDamage for exactly this

tags.param: WHICH stat stages come off the foe, not just that some do
tags.why: Charm, Fake Tears, Scary Face, Tickle, Strength Sap. -1 Spe flips the order, -1 Atk halves their physical output. What Clear Amulet and White Herb answer

tags.param: the user dies as the cost
tags.why: Memento, Explosion, Final Gambit, Healing Wish. Final Gambit is 176 uses and deals damage equal to the user remaining HP, which the damage engine reads as ZERO

tags.param: category is Status: Prankster +1, blanked by Taunt, illegal under Assault Vest
tags.why: The class Prankster boosts and Taunt deletes. isStatus exists as a FEATURE but was never a named parameter, so nothing connected it to priorityMod or to Taunt

tags.param: their option set collapses to one specific move, or loses one
tags.why: Encore pins them to their last move, Disable removes it, Torment blocks the repeat. stallIntoEncore already prices the Encore case from the RECEIVING end

tags.param: the whole Status CATEGORY becomes unclickable for them
tags.why: Taunt. Deletes every Protect, setup move and Tailwind at once -- 38.5% of their move slots by share. Same restriction Assault Vest applies to its own holder

tags.param: P(burn): x0.5 physical damage on them, plus chip
tags.why: Will-O-Wisp as the move, Flare Blitz and Matcha Gotcha as a secondary. Halving their physical output is a damage parameter, not a status footnote

tags.param: P(paralysis): x0.5 their speed, plus 12.5% lost turns
tags.why: Changes who moves first, which most kill features hang off. Champions uses 12.5% full-para, not the 25% everywhere else

tags.param: P(sleep): they lose turns outright
tags.why: The most valuable status in the game and the one Electric Terrain blanks

tags.param: P(poison): flat 1/8 chip a turn
tags.why: Poison Jab (758 uses), Baneful Bunker on contact. Prices the long game, not this turn

tags.param: P(badly poisoned): n/16 ESCALATING, not a flat 1/8
tags.why: Toxic, 480 uses. By turn six it is doing more than triple what regular poison does, so it is a different clock entirely

tags.param: they fall asleep at the end of NEXT turn unless they switch
tags.why: Yawn, 536 uses. Not a status this turn -- a threat that forces a switch, which is the whole point of clicking it

tags.param: everything on the field dies in 3 turns unless it switches
tags.why: Perish Song, 560 uses. Ignores HP, typing, items and abilities. No damage feature can see it and no kill calculation applies

tags.param: status := x (any)
tags.why: burn halves physical damage, paralysis halves speed -- both are damage/order parameters

tags.param: heals a fraction of damage dealt
tags.why: changes the value of clicking it into a healthy target

tags.param: the user pays a FRACTION of the damage dealt
tags.why: Head Smash 1/2, Flare Blitz and Wave Crash 33/100 at ~4,000 uses each, Wild Charge 1/4. A cost nothing prices

tags.param: restores a share of MY max HP, costing the turn
tags.why: Wish, Rest, Slack Off, Synthesis, Moonlight. Trades tempo for bulk, which nothing prices

tags.param: restores my PARTNER max-HP share
tags.why: Heal Pulse, Life Dew, Floral Healing. Already a pair feature in DODUO and nothing in the single-move vector

tags.param: costs a turn before it lands
tags.why: and the request omits the target field on the locked turn, which already broke the player once

tags.param: the charge turn DISAPPEARS under one weather
tags.why: Electro Shot in rain, Solar Beam and Solar Blade in sun. Same move, no downside, and the weather that does it is usually one the user set themselves

tags.param: costs the turn AFTER it lands
tags.why: Hyper Beam. A free turn for the opponent

tags.param: P(flinch), 10% to 100%, and only if I move first
tags.why: Fake Out 100% at +3, Rock Slide 30%, Iron Head 20%, the fangs 10%. Blocked by Covert Cloak and Inner Focus, neither of which is checked

tags.param: the defender's ability does not apply
tags.why: Mold Breaker-style moves walk through Levitate and the damage-reducing abilities

tags.param: removes the target outright
tags.why: a different kill calculation entirely

tags.param: the holder becomes another species
tags.why: different stats, typing and ability from turn one

tags.param: a lethal hit from full HP leaves 1
tags.why: Focus Sash, the most-held item in the format. Broken by multi-hit moves and by any prior chip

tags.param: the holder is locked into one move
tags.why: the single strongest thing an open sheet tells you about what they can do next turn

tags.param: speed x1.5
tags.why: order, which most kill features hang off

tags.param: x damage on everything
tags.why: Life Orb 1.3, at a cost this does not model

tags.param: x1.2 on one type
tags.why: Charcoal, Black Glasses, Mystic Water, Fairy Feather. About 6.7% of held items and a pure calculation error

tags.param: halves one super-effective hit, then is gone
tags.why: Chople, Colbur, Kasib, Occa. About 6.8% of held items and it turns kills into non-kills

tags.param: a status is removed the moment it lands
tags.why: Lum (107 uses), Chesto, Rawst. Every status move aimed at the holder is a wasted turn, and inflictsStatus has no idea

tags.param: restores 25% when it drops below half
tags.why: Sitrus, 10.8% of items. Modelled in the rollout engine only, invisible to MAG

tags.param: restores HP every turn
tags.why: changes how many turns a kill takes

tags.param: added effects do not apply to the holder
tags.why: Covert Cloak. Fake Out does not flinch through it, and nothing checks

tags.param: powder moves fail against the holder
tags.why: Safety Goggles beats Rage Powder redirection outright

tags.param: stat drops do not apply
tags.why: Clear Amulet turns Intimidate into nothing

tags.param: undoes stat drops once
tags.why: 2.1% of items, and it changes what a drop is worth

tags.param: side conditions last 8 turns not 5
tags.why: 3.1% of items

tags.param: hurts anything that makes contact
tags.why: a cost of clicking a contact move that is not currently priced

tags.param: the charge turn is skipped for any charge move
tags.why: Power Herb. Not legal in Reg M-B today; tagged so a format change does not silently leave a two-turn move scored as two turns

tags.param: P(crit) raised
tags.why: Scope Lens (Will spotted this one missing). Rare at 0.11% of items, but it sets a parameter the distribution already needs for Flower Trick, so it costs nothing to support. NOTE the ratio is a STAGE feeding P(crit); the crit damage multiplier is always x1.5 and nothing here changes it -- do not read critRatio: 2 as double damage

tags.param: P(flinch) += 10% on moves that do not already flinch
tags.why: King's Rock and Razor Fang. Sets the same parameter the move-side flinch tag does, which is exactly what a parameter taxonomy is for. Derived from an onModifyMove that mentions flinch, not from the names

tags.param: a CHANCE to move first inside the priority bracket
tags.why: Quick Claw, 20% of turns. Speed order is what most kill features hang off, and this makes it probabilistic rather than determined

tags.param: P(hit) is scaled, for or against the holder
tags.why: Bright Powder makes attacks against the holder 0.9x; Wide Lens (411 uses) makes the holder 1.1x. Feeds the same P(hit) the kill distribution consumes

tags.param: raises one stat
tags.why: Band, Specs, Assault Vest, Eviolite

tags.param: a lethal hit from full HP leaves 1
tags.why: Sturdy. Identical to Focus Sash and NOT modelled anywhere -- verified 0 mentions

tags.param: P(crit) raised
tags.why: Super Luck and Merciless. Same parameter as Scope Lens and Flower Trick

tags.param: suppress every defender-side ability tag for this move
tags.why: Mold Breaker, Turboblaze, Teravolt. Gates typeImmunity, damageReduce, blocksMove, preventsCrit and Sturdy in one flag

tags.param: the CRIT MULTIPLIER itself, not its probability
tags.why: Sniper (Will raised it). Three separate crit parameters exist and the taxonomy had only two: probability (Scope Lens, Flower Trick), prevention (Shell Armor) and now the multiplier. Crit damage is x1.5 and Sniper makes it x1.5 again, so x2.25 total -- it was x3 in the old gens when crits themselves were x2, which is where the folklore comes from

tags.param: the move I just used is removed from MY options
tags.why: Cursed Body (833 uses). Not damage and not a stat change -- it shrinks my own option set, the same shape as locksTarget from the receiving end

tags.param: P(crit) = 0
tags.why: Shell Armor and Battle Armor. Turns Flower Trick from a guaranteed crit into an ordinary hit

tags.param: weather := x on switch-in
tags.why: and megaing can COST you it, which is Will's reason to decline a mega

tags.param: terrain := x on switch-in
tags.why: same shape as weather

tags.param: speed x2 under a condition
tags.why: Chlorophyll, Swift Swim, Sand Rush, Slush Rush, Unburden, Quick Feet. Already probed for the speed order

tags.param: damage of one TYPE := 0
tags.why: Levitate, Water Absorb, Flash Fire, Sap Sipper. Clicking into one wastes the turn entirely

tags.param: draws that type to itself
tags.why: Lightning Rod and Storm Drain redirect AND boost

tags.param: the target gains something for being hit
tags.why: Stamina, Weak Armour, Berserk, Anger Shell, Justified, Rattled. Task #18 -- Will's Bellibolt case

tags.param: the ATTACKER pays for touching it
tags.why: Rough Skin (3,739), Static, Flame Body, Poison Point, Cute Charm, Effect Spore, Mummy, Gooey. Derived by reading the handler for checkMoveMakesContact

tags.param: x<1 damage taken
tags.why: Filter, Solid Rock, Multiscale, Thick Fat, Heatproof, Fluffy. Overcalling kills without them

tags.param: x>1 damage dealt
tags.why: Adaptability, Technician, Tinted Lens, Sheer Force, Iron Fist, Strong Jaw

tags.param: a whole class of move fails
tags.why: already derived for allySideBlockProb -- Dazzling, Armor Tail, Good as Gold

tags.param: stat changes flip sign
tags.why: Contrary and Simple, already probed for expectedBoostSign

tags.param: order shifts for a class of move
tags.why: Prankster, Gale Wings, Triage. stallIntoEncore already depends on it

tags.param: the foe cannot leave
tags.why: Shadow Tag, Arena Trap, Magnet Pull. Already used by the playstyle classifier

tags.param: stat stages on the foe at switch-in
tags.why: Intimidate. Beaten by Clear Amulet and by White Herb, neither of which is checked

tags.param: the species changes mid-battle
tags.why: Zero to Hero (needs a switch), Illusion, Imposter, Disguise

tags.param: a status cannot land
tags.why: Limber, Immunity, Insomnia, Vital Spirit, Water Veil, Magma Armor. onSetStatus only -- onImmunity also means weather-chip immunity and was over-capturing

tags.param: P(hit) scaled, often gated on a weather or a category
tags.why: Sand Veil (135 uses, x1.25 evasion in sand), Snow Cloak (219, in snow), Compound Eyes, Victory Star, Hustle, Wonder Skin, No Guard. Same P(hit) the kill distribution needs

tags.param: takes no sandstorm or snow residual damage
tags.why: What onImmunity actually means for Sand Veil, Snow Cloak, Overcoat and Magic Guard -- and what typeImmunity was wrongly reporting until Will asked
